ST-Standard GM-08 Virtual 7.1 Surround Sound RGB Gaming Headset (50mm High-Precision Drivers / Noise-Reduction Flexible Mic / Dynamic RGB Lighting / Heavy Duty USB Cable / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Gain a critical sound positioning advantage with the ST-Standard GM-08 Virtual 7.1 Surround Sound RGB Gaming Headset, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Powered by high-output 50mm neodymium audio drivers, this headset produces clear acoustic feedback, rich bass tones, and detailed directional sound staging for intense gaming sessions. Designed with an ergonomic auto-adjusting headband suspension and high-density memory foam ear cushions, it provides exceptional noise isolation and pressure relief for extended wear. The GM-08 incorporates a flexible omnidirectional microphone equipped with noise-reduction filtering to ensure crystal-clear voice communication with teammates. Finished with vivid dynamic RGB lighting accents and connected through a durable high-grade USB cable, this headset offers instant plug-and-play setup for gaming PCs and laptops.
